task.title: Render a task's own pending decisions in the human briefing
task.description: Repro: from a repo with a decision-blocked task run ask-decision on it, then show it. The human output omits the pending decision entirely, while show --json carries it under task.decisions (status, category, proposed_options). Evidence: format_task_briefing renders inherited_decisions only, and there is no reference to .decisions anywhere in storypole-cli, so a task's own decision is never printed. Observed against AF-17 and AF-18 in the aerofoil backlog on storypole 0.1.0-beta.2 and still present on main at 09557e7.
acceptance_criteria: show KEY renders each own decision with status, category, question and proposed options; a pending decision is distinguishable from a resolved one; list marks a task that is blocked by a decision so the reason is not invisible
